features.title: Persist schema-validated client values
features.summary: Read fallback values for missing, malformed, or invalid storage, persist only schema-valid writes, react to other-tab changes, and report unavailable writes without losing in-memory state.
failureModes: Invalid storage is not propagated as a valid value.
Storage denial leaves a usable in-memory value and exposes failure status.

verification.testName: persists valid writes and rejects invalid ones
follows another tab through the storage event
keeps the value in memory and reports false when storage refuses the write

features.title: Compose validated forms and accessible data tables

failureModes: Invalid form values are not submitted.
An empty table preserves its column structure and accessible headers.

features.title: Debounce fast-changing client input
features.summary: Publish only the final value after the configured delay so search and preference consumers avoid redundant work.
failureModes: A superseded value is never published after the latest value wins.

verification.testName: publishes only the last value after the delay

features.title: Give kit controls a 44px touch target
features.summary: On a coarse pointer every kit button, toggle and toggle-group item gets a hit area of at least 44px centred on it through an absolutely positioned ::after (page tabs through ::before, since ::after draws their underline), and menu, select and command rows get a 44px row. The drawn size and the layout do not change, so the dense desktop layout is identical and a 24px icon button is still easy to hit on a phone. The rule sits in the base layer, so a positioning utility on a control still wins.
failureModes: A control inside an overflow-clipped parent keeps only the part of its hit area the parent shows.

verification.testName: widens kit buttons, toggles and page tabs to a 44px hit area on a coarse pointer only

verification.reason: Pointer media queries need a touch browser: the WebKit iPhone audit plans/ade-ux/phase6/capture/audit.mjs measures each control's hit area (drawn box plus ::after) and reports any under 44px.

telemetry.reason: Client-only stylesheet rules; no Host work.

features.title: Animate components with one shared motion layer
features.summary: Expose Motion's framework-free core with shared spring, duration, easing and enter presets, reduced-motion handling, FLIP lists, count-ups and rolling digits, so every animated plugin component moves the same way.
failureModes: Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation ends at its final frame at once, and removed list items leave immediately.

verification.testName: ends animations instantly under reduced motion
keeps a removed PresenceList item until its exit ends, hidden from assistive tech
exposes the plain value of a RollingNumber to screen readers

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the motion layer animates DOM in the browser and starts no Host work of its own.
